related_questions.question: How much is the SGLI payout for the military?
related_questions.snippet: Servicemembers' Group Life Insurance (SGLI) provides low-cost group term life insurance for active-duty servicemembers. On March 1, 2023 SGLI coverage increased to $500,000 for all active-duty servicemembers, including those who previously declined or reduced their coverage.
